text: My son Jamie is 7 and has had a temperature since yesterday, 38 tonight. He was sick once this afternoon but he's kept water and squash down since then without any problem. The thing I'm noticing is he's just not himself. He's been asleep most of the evening and when I went to wake him for his medicine it took a lot to get him to come round, and even then he barely looked at me and went straight back off. He's normally a light sleeper and full of chat. Wanted to run it past someone.
